name: Araden
slug: A magically capable companion brought secretly to The Reach.
description: Araden is a previously established NPC/companion associated with the party. Araden is highly capable with magic. The party believes Araden may be an ancient dragon, but this is not established as fact.

log.summary: Walker intends for Araden to accompany him and Elrus to The Reach as part of the scouting group. The party views Araden as a secret weapon whose capabilities should remain unknown to Grixto, particularly until the eventual confrontation. Araden ultimately accompanies Elrus and Walker through the gate to The Reach.
notes: Walker intends to bring Araden to The Reach as part of the scouting group.
The party believes Araden is an ancient dragon and is highly skilled in magic.
Walker considers Araden one of the party's secret weapons that Grixto does not yet know about.

log.summary: Araden splits from Walker and Plymouth during the Reach excursion, flying into the mountains with Elrus while the others detour to Sunder. During Walker's visit to Hanzuni at Haven Hold, the ancient copper dragon's scales are noted as less tarnished than Araden's, apparently from greater activity and contact with treasure.
notes: Flies with Elrus to the mountains while Walker and Plymouth shop in Sunder.
Hanzuni's scales are less tarnished than Araden's, apparently from greater activity and contact with treasure.

log.summary: With Elrus, Araden brought about Grixto's demise. She accompanies Walker to the training island, but she cannot fit into the crevice and stays outside. She can raise a giant ruckus if Walker needs help. Digging the crevice open would take her a long time, so Elrus is the faster backup. The largest cliff roosts are about the size of the entrance to her roost.

log.summary: Araden arrives with Glimmen near Langdale Stronghold as a dragon several sizes larger than Glimmen. The village, used to Glimmen alone, buzzes at the second dragon. Araden is cited as agreeing to leave the Grazog trip and go toward the forest disturbance, then flies with Walker and Glimmen after Dana and matches pace over the beacon.

Cited as agreeing to leave the Grazog trip and go toward the forest disturbance. Flies with Walker and Glimmen after Dana and matches pace over the beacon.

log.summary: Araden is Elrus's ancient copper dragon, large enough that landing in New Navel means curling her wings and keeping her tail off the roofs. Dana identifies her as the dragon of the rider mentoring Walker, not as Glimmen. She flies Elrus and the Carlkin group to the lighthouse, carries Ciri and Ord, and sets Elrus down at Carlkin's door. She tells Ciri, "Don't worry, little one. I will carry you," and tells Ord not to worry, addressing him as young Lane, tapping his chest, and saying his wings are in there. Carlkin already knows her and is put out that nobody told him she had been brought. She perks up when Benji comes toward her, and Glimmen lands beside her. She flies faster than an average ship. Carlkin says entering the Sunder Chase with her would now be cheating and would get a rider disqualified. Walker counts her voice among the familiar voices that would not count as Carlkin's possession warning.

log.summary: Araden is now openly a dragon, too large to fit comfortably inside the stronghold, so he lounges at its foot. He has produced a large inventory of books and spends time chatting with Glimmen. About a dozen village children gather near him and Glimmen.
